cands.name: Will Barfoot

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama Senate District 25, in office since November 2018. He is a Montgomery attorney and co-founder of the personal injury firm Barfoot & Schoettker. He served as a temporary probate judge in Montgomery County in 2005 and chaired the Senate Judiciary Committee in 2025-2026.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Barfoot was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. The pages we read show no stated positions or specific actions on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion or school choice. Ballotpedia's list of bills he sponsored was empty in the page text we read. No endorsements for him were identified, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. No documented controversies or foreign ties turned up in the pages we read.

cands.name: Phadra Carson Foster

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.

cands.bio: Educator, advocate and college instructor. Worked with the Alabama Historical Commission and the Central Alabama Fair Housing Center. Holds a Master of Liberal Arts in English and Theatre and a Master of Legal Studies in Conflict Resolution. Democratic candidate for Alabama State Senate District 25 in 2026.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as receiving voter guide recommendations from Tabitha's List and from Unburdening The Ballot (Sway voting groups).

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was born or raised or when she came to Alabama. We found no dates or employers for her jobs, and no record of elected office. We found no stated positions on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or school choice. Her platform is general: economic security, healthcare access, education and accountability. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. We found no news coverage or controversies about her.
